designer.title: Design the Portfolio dashboard
designer.intro: Add visuals, drag them into place, size them by their corner and choose what each one shows. The design you save is what everyone sees on the Portfolio dashboard.
designer.selectHint: Choose the pencil on a visual to change it.
designer.keyboardHint: Drag a visual by its handle to move it and by its corner to size it. With the keyboard, use the arrow keys on either handle; Delete removes the visual.
designer.empty: Add a visual from the list to start.
designer.saved: The design was saved. Everyone now sees it on the Portfolio dashboard.
designer.resetConfirm: Everyone will see the standard design again, and the saved design will be removed.
designer.noRoom: There is no free place for that. Make the visual smaller or move another one.
designer.galleryHint: Choose a type to place it on the dashboard.
designer.sectionsHint: The dashboard's tables, lists, map and widgets. Each is placed once.
designer.sectionSettings: A section shows its own figures; set its titles and size here.
